ground_truth.description: The MemoryTab grid container was changed from `cols-4` to `cols-5`, but `styles.css` (bumped to v23) only defines `.cols-2`, `.cols-3`, `.cols-4`, and `.cols-12` — there is no `.cols-5` rule. Since `.grid` only sets `display: grid` with no `grid-template-columns`, the five stat tiles fall back to a single implicit column and stack vertically instead of laying out in five columns, breaking the Memory panel layout.

The new overview item passes a `title` key (`title: D.MEMORY_STATUS.started_at || undefined`) intended as a tooltip, but the item objects in this list are otherwise shaped with `l`/`sub`/`ok`/`warn`; unless the rendering component explicitly reads `title`, the started_at tooltip is silently dropped and the value is never surfaced.

The new `fmtUptime` JS helper (with several branch/boundary cases and null/NaN/negative guards) has no unit test; the added Python tests only cover `shape_memory` field passthrough, so the client-side formatting logic is entirely untested.
